capabilities.description: DEBUG ONLY. Lets the app reach a local Worker (wrangler dev, port 8787) so feedback and sync can be tried before the real Worker is deployed. Merged only by `tauri build --debug --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json` (or `tauri dev --config ...`); a plain `tauri build` never reads this file, so a release has no localhost scope.
